display_title: Diary of a Dine-and-dash Criminal XX
description:
Ryu Yeong-Won: the top starting pitcher—and the worst scammer in history, who took 1 billion won and vanished. While in the midst of a terrible slump and keeping a low profile, a delivery mix-up leads him to meet his fan, Jeong Ji-Min. 

 *“If you have time, would you like to grab some chicken before you go?”*

It started as a drunken fling, but he realized that whenever he slept with this woman, his slump would disappear. 

 *“So I just need to do this for you regularly, right?”
“Yeah, yeah?”
“Let’s give it our all. For the Hounds!”*

Driven by his desperate desire to return to the league and his fervent hope for the Seoul Hounds’ revival, they joined forces. As their relationship deepens, so do their feelings, but the more it does, the more their roles as fan and player hold Ryu back…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
